incoming.name: Cloud
incoming.excerpt: The Cassini-Huygens Saturn mission has uncovered evidence of a fluid cycle on Titan, including fluvial channels on the surface of the moon.

incoming.name: Weather
incoming.excerpt: The Cassini-Huygens mission to Titan, for example, discovered clouds formed from methane or ethane which deposit rain composed of liquid methane and other organic compounds.
